name: hideTitle
label: Hide title
description: Hides your title when selected

name: carouselTitle
label: Title
description: Identifies your content

name: badgeConfig
label: Badge configuration
description: Customizable badge, primarily used to display number of items in the Carousel

name: disableTextWrapping
label: Disable text wrapping
description: Disables title text from wrapping and truncates the title instead

name: titleLevel
label: Title level
description: Defines the HTML <hx> heading element that renders the title

name: titleVariant
label: Title style variant
description: Defines the styling of your title, based off the Heading component

name: titlePosition
label: Title location
description: Location you want your title to appear

name: hideLink
label: Hide view all link
description: Hides the link that appears in the top right corner of the carousel when selected

name: linkIcon
label: Link icon
description: The icon to display at the end of the link text

name: linkText
label: Link text
description: Describes the View all link

name: emptyStateLabel
label: Empty state heading
description: Shows a heading you enter when the carousel is empty

name: emptyStateContent
label: Empty state message
defaultValue: Please add components into the carousel
description: Shows a message you enter when the carousel is empty

name: emptyStateIllustration
label: Empty state illustration
description: Shows an illustration you select when the carousel is empty

name: itemsInView
label: Number of items in view
description: Defines how to display your carousel items. You can display multiple items or one at a time

name: slidingType
label: Sliding type
description: Determines if a user can move a set of items or one at a time

name: enableAutoScroll
label: Enable auto scroll
description: Carousel content is scrolled automatically at default interval(3000ms) when enabled

name: showCompactView
label: Show compact view
description: Enabling compact view, the 'Autoplay' button is shown before the left arrow button

name: autoScrollSpeed
label: Auto scroll speed
description: Carousel content auto scroll speed interval

name: pauseAutoScroll
label: Pause auto scroll
description: Carousel content auto scroll is paused when enabled

name: disableLooping
label: Disable looping
description: Disable looping when selected. When disabled, the left arrow on the first slide and the right arrow on the last slide do not appear

name: navPosition
label: Left/right navigation controls location
description: The location of the arrows and indicators based on the option

name: gradientStyle
label: Navigation control gradient color
description: The color of the gradient surrounding the navigation controls

name: enableAdvancedNavConfig
label: Enable advanced navigation configuration
description: Enables advanced configuration of the navigation control buttons

name: leftNavButtonIcon
label: Left navigation button icon
description: Defines the icon for the left iconic button navigation control

name: rightNavButtonIcon
label: Right navigation button icon
description: Defines the icon for the right iconic button navigation control

name: navStyle
label: Navigation control style
description: Defines how your navigation controls look

name: navButtonConfig
label: Navigation control configuration
description: Defines the properties for iconic button navigation control

name: hideDotIndicator
label: Hide dot indicator
description: Hides the dot incidators when selected

name: startingIndex
label: View index
description: Starts the carousel at the indicator position provided by the index

name: singleItemOnZoom
label: Display single item when zoomed in 400%
description: Changes the number of items in view to single item when zoomed-in to 400% or higher
